bounds: The zh-CN images are their OWN runs, not renamed copies: the WEB twin renders in the app's Chinese locale (browser context locale zh-CN, body text verified Chinese), and the TUI twin is a separate PTY capture. MEASURED: the TUI DAG page's chrome is English in BOTH locales (DSH_TUI_LANG=zh-CN left the pane byte-identical), which matches the established zh-CN set policy that 'the TUI scene bodies stay English by design'; the zh-CN TUI file is therefore the same scene from its own run, not a Chinese-chrome image.

The zh-CN TUI twin was WITHDRAWN after measurement: DSH_TUI_LANG=en / zh / zh-CN all produce a byte-identical DAG pane (the page's chrome is English in every locale, matching the established 'TUI scene bodies stay English by design' policy), so a zh-CN copy would be a byte-identical duplicate. The zh README + zh docs row cite the SHARED English-body TUI capture and say so in the caption; the three panes are kept here as the measurement.

The TUI capture is the team SCENE, the panel's own full-screen surface: it draws the group frame at the scene's full width, so the sidebar's narrow-width collapse bound (D3) never applies here and the frame is not half-drawn.
The web crop keeps the panel header + roster + the whole task graph; the empty space below the graph is dropped, not painted over.
The frame is CLOSED: the bottom border carries a crossing glyph (U+256B) where the outgoing edge leaves the box, and all four interior cards sit inside it.

The re-rendered PNG is MONOCHROME by force of its archive: the capture that was committed is 'tmux capture-pane -p -J' (no SGR escapes, 0 ESC bytes in the file), so the renderer has no colour tones to paint and every glyph uses the page foreground. The grid -- which is what this figure is about -- is exact; the host's tones would need the ANSI stream, which this archive does not carry.

The frame's four sides are measured CLOSED on the shipped pixels: every corner's own vertical stroke shares its x with the adjacent side's stroke to 0.0 px, and no pixel row or column between the corners is left unpainted (evidence/cellwork/shots-fix/2026-10-27T02-46-21Z/measure/after-s2.log).

The Web figure's framing is CHECKED, not asserted: docker/ui/measure-shots.py web reads web.boxes + web.capture and refuses a box whose capture rect falls outside capturedWidth x capturedHeight, a content width larger than the graph viewport, or a scroll origin other than 0. Every future Web capture goes through docker/ui/shoot-team-dag.sh, which runs that gate and exits with its status.

The TUI figure is CHECKED the same way in its own mode: docker/ui/measure-shots.py tui detects the frames in the pane text, walks the shipped pixels, and refuses a corner whose vertical stroke is more than 1 px from its side's stroke or a vertical side with an unpainted pixel row. docker/ui/tui-capture.sh runs it after rendering scene 1 and deletes the PNG on failure.

The scene's OWN panel frame running off the window's right edge is not a defect: the figure is a documented WINDOW (cols 0:109 of 158), exactly as tui-team-dag-groups.png stops at 102 of 158. The tool reports that frame separately from a cut CARD.
